data.body: **[P1] Claim checkpoint publication failures before releasing the completion lock.** `persistence.run()` includes the synchronous child checkpoint, whose failure is surfaced as a wrapped `UnrecoverableDurableExecutionException` and bypasses this payload-only catch. A waiting coordinator can then checkpoint early parent success before the child terminates the invocation, allowing replay to skip the child despite the transport failure. Unwrap and claim invocation-level checkpoint failures while holding this lock, then add a race test with a failing child checkpoint and waiting early completion.
